edges.description: Biochemical redox effects are demonstrated for E493V and E336K.
Reduced AIF abundance and protein instability were reported for E336K.
F210L is associated with an assembly defect despite retained AIF/MIA40 binding; the intervening mechanism is unresolved.
E493V cosegregated with Cowchock syndrome, including hearing loss in affected family members; the cellular mechanism producing the auditory feature is not established.
E493V cosegregated with Cowchock syndrome, including cognitive impairment in some affected family members; the cellular mechanism is not established and cognition is preserved in other kindreds.
Cerebellar ataxia occurred variably in affected males of the Irish AIFM1 family; the cellular mechanism linking the variant to ataxia is unresolved.
Pyramidal involvement occurred variably in affected males of the Irish AIFM1 family; the cellular mechanism linking the variant to corticospinal signs is unresolved.
Two brothers carrying the maternally inherited H457Y variant had disabling tremor; the mechanism linking the variant to this movement disorder is unresolved.
Colour vision deficiency occurred in three affected males of the Irish AIFM1 family; screening for other colour-deficiency genes was negative, but the cellular mechanism remains unresolved.
All four imaged affected males in the Irish AIFM1 family had varying cerebellar atrophy; the cellular mechanism connecting the variant to tissue loss is unresolved.
For p.Glu493Val, the authors propose that faster oxidation of the charge-transfer complex favors apoptogenic AIF. The causal connection to neuronal loss remains inferred.

For p.Glu336Lys, altered NADH-dependent regulation and weakened CHCHD4 engagement may contribute to respiratory-supercomplex abnormalities in fibroblasts. This route is not demonstrated for p.Glu493Val.
Lower AIF abundance and impaired CHCHD4 engagement accompany reduced CHCHD4 expression in E336K cells; the regulatory steps linking them remain unresolved.
Reduced CHCHD4 expression may contribute to the E336K assembly phenotype through mitochondrial protein import; these experiments did not isolate a complete causal sequence.
Fibroblast assembly defects provide a plausible model for neuronal mitochondrial dysfunction, but respiratory-complex assembly was not directly measured in peripheral neurons in these studies.
Apoptotic susceptibility is proposed to contribute to the p.Glu493Val neuropathy. Direct death measurements in affected peripheral neurons are unavailable.
Mitochondrial abnormalities in affected nerve suggest a contribution to axonal injury; the intervening causal steps have not been demonstrated.

nodes.description: Purified p.Glu493Val AIF is reduced more rapidly by NADH and forms a shorter-lived charge-transfer complex. NADH-induced dimer formation is retained. Purified p.Glu336Lys AIF instead has reduced NADH affinity, less stable reduced dimers and weakened CHCHD4 binding. These variant-specific biochemical changes affect AIF regulation; they do not establish a common dimerization failure or respiratory-chain defect across CMTX4.

nodes.description: Skin fibroblasts carrying p.Glu493Val showed increased staurosporine-induced nuclear abnormalities that persisted despite caspase inhibition. Patient muscle showed TUNEL-positive nuclei and increased nuclear AIF localization. These experiments support enhanced apoptotic susceptibility for this variant; they did not directly assay motor, sensory, auditory or central neurons. Increased apoptosis is not a universal CMTX4 mechanism: p.Glu336Lys fibroblasts showed attenuated MNNG-induced cell death.

nodes.description: The final common pathway in CMTX4 is length-dependent axonal degeneration of peripheral nerves, producing a large-fibre sensorimotor axonal neuropathy. The longest axons — those of the distal lower limbs — are affected first, yielding the characteristic distal-predominant weakness, atrophy, and sensory loss.

nodes.description: Patient-derived p.Phe210Leu fibroblasts had reduced complex I and III subunit signals interpreted as misassembly, despite preserved AIF/MIA40 abundance and binding. The study measured one subunit per complex, limiting inference about the entire complex. p.Glu336Lys fibroblasts had altered respiratory-supercomplex organization, reduced CHCHD4 abundance and decreased basal respiration.
